what_this_is: THE ROUTING LAYER: for each TransformFit artifact type, maps the artifact to which gates run on it. Tier-1 gates are BUILT, mechanical, fail-closed (GREEN/RED only). Tier-2 (adversarial teardown vs named-gold) and Tier-3 (coach/buyer panel + metric trace) are DEFINED now as future HUMAN-GATE-ONLY RECORDED-PENDING gates — never auto-green, never blocking in this mission (built once gold is calibrated in M3+). Mirrors rig-design-studio/gtm/bridge.json + gate-shared.mjs (the anti-fake-green law: a human-gate-only gate may NEVER emit GREEN).

build_test_gate.pass_condition: flutter analyze AND flutter test green (exit 0)

adversarial_teardown.note: DEFINED now, BUILT in a later mission once gold is calibrated (M3). Independent agent panel scores the artifact vs the named GOLD per surface. Never auto-green; RECORDED-PENDING until a human signs the verdict under the DUAL GATE.

coach_buyer_panel.pass_condition: verdict = BOOK (Marcus/David/Jordan persona panel + coach-presence check)
coach_buyer_panel.metric_trace: does it move Week-2 activation? (>=30% Week-2 activated retention = >=3 readiness-adjusted sessions in 14 days)
coach_buyer_panel.note: DEFINED now, BUILT in a later mission. Marcus/David/Jordan persona panel + coach-presence check (>=1 specific observation + forward hook + identity tie) + the metric trace (does it move Week-2 activation?). Never auto-green; RECORDED-PENDING until a human signs the verdict under the DUAL GATE.

ship_law: A TransformFit artifact ships ONLY on a hard-AND of the BUILT mechanical Tier-1 gates that apply to its type (each GREEN, one RED blocks ship) AND a sealed ProofPacket (proof-or-it-didn't-happen). The future HUMAN-GATE-ONLY members (adversarial_teardown, coach_buyer_panel) are DEFINED as RECORDED-PENDING — they are neither auto-greened nor fatally blocking in this mission; at runtime the ship-gate logs them as RECORDED-PENDING/future. Maker != grader. Mechanical RED blocks ship; human members are signed, not code-checked.

screen.description: A Flutter screen / view (the daily wake-up loop, Moments of Truth, danger-zone interventions).

tier_1.why: screen must satisfy L4 design laws (orange<=3, WCAG AA, font-role, radius)
screen must compile (flutter analyze) and its widget tests must pass

tier_2.why: screen scored vs named-gold for its surface; authored-exp >= 86 + activation >= 82

tier_3.why: Marcus/David/Jordan panel: does this screen move Week-2 activation? BOOK verdict

feature.description: A Flutter feature module (state, logic, integration) — e.g. readiness engine, dai-adapt narration.

tier_1.why: feature must compile and its unit/widget tests must pass
feature copy / surfaced strings must be free of banned anti-patterns (incl. silent-fallback)

tier_2.why: feature scored vs named-gold for its surface; authored-exp >= 86 + activation >= 82

tier_3.why: does this feature move Week-2 activation? BOOK verdict

coach_message.description: A coach-voice message (the 8 L1 message rules + L2 banned anti-patterns apply).

tier_1.why: message must be free of L1/L2 banned anti-patterns (body-shame, slop, false promises, streak-shame, silent-fallback)
message must satisfy all 8 L1 message rules (<=60 words, no emoji, >=1 data token, <=1 question, echo, no generic encouragement, honest uncertainty, weave memory)

tier_2.why: message scored vs named-gold for the coach-voice surface; authored-exp >= 86 + activation >= 82

tier_3.why: does this message move Week-2 activation? coach-presence check + BOOK verdict

copy.description: Marketing / in-app copy (paywall, onboarding, upgrade, notification).

tier_1.why: copy must be free of L1/L2 banned anti-patterns (false promises, fake scarcity, dark-pattern cancel)
copy must satisfy the 8 L1 message rules where applicable (concise, no emoji, specific, honest)

tier_2.why: copy scored vs named-gold for its surface; authored-exp >= 86 + activation >= 82

tier_3.why: does this copy move Week-2 activation? BOOK verdict

edge_function.description: A Supabase edge function / backend handler (the dai-adapt invariant lives here).

tier_1.why: edge-function surfaced strings must be free of banned anti-patterns; the silent hardcoded-template fallback is a banned L1 pattern (the dai-adapt invariant)
edge function must compile (analyze) and its tests must pass

tier_2.why: edge function scored vs named-gold; authored-exp >= 86 + activation >= 82

tier_3.why: does this edge function's surfaced output move Week-2 activation? BOOK verdict + metric trace

gate_maturity.note: Tier-2 (adversarial_teardown) and Tier-3 (coach_buyer_panel) are DEFINED now as future HUMAN-GATE-ONLY RECORDED-PENDING gates. They are never auto-greened. A later mission adds runners so they can graduate into the mechanical hard-AND once gold is calibrated (M3).
